purpose: Verified exercise-specific movement demo source mapping for existing 12-week barbell program.

mediaPolicy: The dataset's MIT license clearly covers software and metadata, but check separate media ownership/hosting rights before copying videos to Field Strength. External GIF and video guides are linked, not copied. YouTube playback should use its normal embed when permitted.
